existing_outcome_summaries.qualitative_outcome: Single injections of either HGF or EGF mRNA-LNP decreased steatosis; combined HGF/EGF mRNA-LNP produced more efficient steatosis reversal. A sharp decrease was observed 2 days after the first combined injection, while steatosis was maintained in Poly(C) RNA-LNP-treated mice.

existing_outcome_summaries.qualitative_outcome: ALT was restored to normal levels at T2 after HGF/EGF mRNA-LNP; control ALT levels remained significantly greater.
At 24 h after HGF/EGF mRNA-LNP administration, necrotic areas had accelerated disappearance versus Poly(C) RNA-LNP controls; at 8 h there was no significant improvement.
